info.title: YixuMemory P0 API draft
info.description: Design only; no deployed service. Server AuthContext is authoritative. Tenant path never grants permission. All writes reauthorize. Staged payload upload, grant management, archive, conflict resolution and SDK generation are reserved for later API revisions. Source erasure requires explicit erase-source capability and computes full dependency closure.
